sentences.text:
THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.K. SAHOO THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE CHITTARANJAN DASH Order No. ORDER 10.09.2024 01. This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

The petitioner has filed this writ petition with a prayer to direct the opposite parties more particularly opposite party no.3- the Special Land Acquisition Officer -cum- RRO, Lower Indra Irrigation Project, Khariar, Nuapada to allow him to withdraw the application under section 28-A of L.A. Act under Annexure-2 or correct the area of the land as has been mentioned in the said application with a further direction to the opposite party no.3 to accept the application under section 28-A(3) of the L.A. Act filed by him under Annexure-3 for referring the matter to the learned Civil Court for determination of the compensation amount due to acquisition of his land for construction of Lower Indra Irrigation Project, Khariar.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has submitted an application before the opposite party no.3 on 02.08.2024 vide Annexure-3 highlighting his grievances, but he has not received any communication from the concerned Authority relating to the status of the application and therefore, a direction may be given to dispose of the same within a specified period.
Learned counsel for the State has no objection to such submission.

sentences.text: Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the respective parties, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the claim of the petitioner, we dispose of the writ petition directing the opposite party no.3- the Special Land Acquisition Officer -cum- RRO, Lower Indra Irrigation Project, Khariar, Nuapada to take a decision on the application filed by the petitioner vide Annexure-3 and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of a certified copy of this order and communicate the result/decision taken thereon to the petitioner within two weeks thereafter.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge ( Chittaranjan Dash) Judge RKM Signed by: RABINDRA KUMAR MISHRA
